mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return in FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods is negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 5.0% signals accelerating inflation, which triggers central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%, or the Rank IC of CPIAUCSL with 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return in periods with PAYEMS growth >= 0.5% and UNRATE decline >= 0.1pp is negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST above 1700 thousand units), rising home construction activity signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1700, or the Rank IC of HOUST with 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1700, or the Rank IC of HOUST with 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market, which supports corporate profit margins and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 60-day forward return when UNRATE < 4.0% is negative (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Average 20-day forward return in periods with CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25pp is positive (t-test p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer spending recovery regime (RSAFS above 650,000 million dollars), rising retail sales signal strong household consumption, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 650000, or the Rank IC of RSAFS with 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
